cells.gaps: The matching figures are the then Vice-President's own, for SSNIT and the National Service Scheme in 2024; no audited figure for the civil service payroll is held. No electoral or business register is found using the number.
cells.note: The payroll, the tax number and SSNIT use the Ghana Card (stage 4), and in September 2024 checks against it removed 29,000 ghost names at SSNIT and 44,000 at the National Service Scheme, a matching figure: stage 5.
